feed.title: Henrique Santana — Blog
feed.subtitle: Notes on AI-assisted development, workflow patterns, and what I'm learning along the way.

entry.title: Your AI Agent Is a New Hire
entry.summary: People are wiring AI agents into production with permissions no human would get on day one. The fix isn't clever prompting. It's the same boring guardrails we use for new hires.

entry.title: One Agent Per Dimension
entry.summary: I stopped asking one AI to review everything at once. Six focused agents, each checking a single dimension, produce sharper feedback in a third of the time.

entry.title: AI Catches Errors It Just Made
entry.summary: The same model that fabricates a claim will flag it as wrong five minutes later in a fresh session. I use that asymmetry as my primary workflow now.

entry.title: I Built a Tool to Score My LinkedIn Profile
entry.summary: I turned a recruiter's profile optimization guide into a scoring tool that reads your LinkedIn data export and tells you exactly what to fix.

entry.title: Skills, Not Prompts
entry.summary: I stopped writing long prompts months ago. Everything I do with AI is skill-based now, and the difference in consistency and speed is enormous.

entry.title: SEO Now Has Two Audiences
entry.summary: Your website has two types of visitors now: humans and AI agents. Most sites are only optimized for one of them.
